Card art uses the built-in image_gen tool. Each transparent strip contains equal J/Q/K cells, left to right. The final KT strip preserves original Ddory/Vic identity and matches the other teams' polished royal costume style; user approved this version. See IMAGE_PROMPTS.md for exact prompts.

- Spades: assets/kt-court.png (Ddory J/Q, Vic K).
- Diamonds: assets/samsung-court.png (Bleo family).
- Hearts: assets/kia-court.png (Hoguli).
- Clubs: assets/lg-court.png (Lucky/Star).

References:
- https://www.ktwiz.co.kr/ktwiz/bi/mascot
- https://www.samsunglions.com/intro/intro04_3.asp
- https://cdn.namdonews.com/news/photo/202305/725746_388265_400.jpg
- https://t1.daumcdn.net/brunch/service/user/1XM2/image/cWXnlmacS8_7f7gOQakwQtpqYlM.png

Art is centered horizontally and vertically inside an inner rectangular frame. Small suit marks sit below rank labels. Card back uses a code-native gold outline baseball with no white fill.
